resources.string: The relay can be scoped to one server so nothing else on the device is touched. Minecraft still connects to this address itself — pick it here, type it in the game the same way.
Routes only this server\'s address into the relay; DNS and everything else stay untouched. Turn it off to relay all of the selected app\'s UDP traffic.
Only this app\'s traffic is captured by the relay.
No traffic yet. Open Minecraft and join a server.

Read-only by design: UDP traffic is relayed unchanged and only observed. Version, account and handshake details come from the login exchange, which is cleartext; game packets are encrypted end-to-end with a key derived between the client and the server, so a relay cannot read coordinates, chat or inventory.
No servers answered. Make sure a world is open to LAN or a server is running on this network.
Minecraft is not installed — nothing to relay.
Shows live connection statistics while the relay is running.
